qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507.mistake: FOL uses exclusive or (⊕) where the natural language uses an inclusive 'or' without specifying mutual exclusivity: 'either gain recognition or earn academic awards' does not imply 'not both'. The FOL statement ∀x (p_2(x) → (p_10(x) ⊕ p_3(x))) therefore adds a constraint not present in the NL.

openai/gpt-5-mini.mistake: Minor ambiguity: the FOL uses exclusive-or (⊕) in some places (e.g. p_2 → (p_10 ⊕ p_3)), while the NL phrase “either ... or ...” can be interpreted inclusively or exclusively. Aside from that natural-language ambiguity, there are no mismatches.
